descriptions.sol29a_motion_flags_800ed938: Looks up the object parameter block through its handle at +192, selects the enable value at +468, +472 or +448 according to the low bit and bit 30 of a 64-bit flag argument, and, when enabled, forwards the object, its +36 subobject and the final two pointer arguments to 0x800ec6a8. The original paired flag-register lifetime and 64-bit comparison witness the argument width.
